caption: The drawing depicts a four-poster bed covered with an elaborate canopy and curtains. The curtains and canopy are deep red and adorned with gold fringes and decorative trim, and large gold leaf-like finials are situated on top of each of the four posts at the corners of the bed. The posts are dark brown and carved with vertical grooves. The drapes hang down on all sides of the bed, with two curtains gathered and tied back at the front left corner post. The bed itself is covered with a white coverlet featuring a subtle embroidered circular pattern. The lower edge of the bed is lined with a matching red fabric skirt that reaches the floor. The background is plain and off-white.
title: High Post Bed
